==Description==
'''Caroling''' is an emote obtained from the [[Operation I.C.E Event#Operation I.C.E Battle Pass|Operation I.C.E Battle Pass]]. It was created by Mewious, MonoGAnim and Jaaziar. It is not moveable and interactable. The emote does have music and it is looped. Once used, music will begin to play, and the player will hold a red covered book. The player will then play one of the seven randomly chosen animations.

This emote could be obtained at Level 28 of the premium track, where it costed {{Bell|940}} or {{Robux|136}} to unlock it, with a total cost of {{Bell|12,510}} or {{Robux|2,752}}.
